title: Kaanchi
desc: Kaanchi, a fearless young woman, witnesses her lover's murder by a powerful politician's son. Fleeing her village, she embarks on a determined quest for justice and revenge.

title: Khamoshiyan
desc: Kabir, a struggling writer, travels to Kashmir for inspiration and starts staying at a mysterious guest house. He falls in love with Meera, the owner of the guesthouse, who harbours a dark secret.

title: Black & White
desc: A suicide bomber befriends a professor in India to sneak into Independence Day celebrations, aiming to execute his deadly mission while grappling with unexpected emotions.

title: Beyond The Clouds
desc: The emotional story of siblings reunited by a drug bust, navigating hardship and hope in the slums of Mumbai as they struggle for survival, forgiveness, and dignity.

title: Kisko Tha Pata
desc: 'Kisko Tha Pata' tells the tale of three interconnected lives. Their stories intertwine, leading to unexpected twists and turns as they navigate love, loss, and fate.

title: Dobaaraa
desc: A woman saves the life of a 12-year old boy who earlier died due to a thunderstorm 25 years ago, by connecting through a TV channel. But, this incident changes her present day life.

title: Yudhra
desc: Yudhra seeks revenge on a cartel for his parents' murder. He infiltrates the group, but uncovers a shocking truth about his own history. This discovery challenges his resolve.

title: Murder At Teesri Manzil 302
desc: An investigating officer pieces together the puzzle of a missing businessman's wife. The more he looks, the more twisted the case gets.

title: Happy Hardy And Heer
desc: Happy loves his childhood friend, Heer, and follows her to London in hopes of wooing her. However, problems arise when Heer falls for an entrepreneur named Hardy.

title: Welcome 2 Karachi
desc: Two friends land up in Karachi without their passports after they are kidnapped during their boat trip. When they realise the severity of being kidnapped by the Taliban, they look for ways to escape.

title: Yeh Zindagi Ka Safar
desc: A young woman's perfect world crumbles after she reads an article written by an ambitious editor. Determined to unearth the truth about her past, she sets out on a painful journey, with him in tow.

title: The Killer
desc: A contract killer hires the services of a cab driver for a full night. Soon, he forces the driver to go around Dubai as he kills witnesses scheduled to testify against a gangster.

title: Akaash Vani
desc: Akaash and Vani are in love. But her parents force her to marry elsewhere because her sister eloped.

title: Laila Majnu
desc: The legendary love story is reimagined in modern Kashmir, portraying obsession, longing, and madness as love defies all social norms and boundaries.

title: Ghoomer
desc: Anina loses her arm, but a failed cricketer reignites her dream using unorthodox training. Together they create 'Ghoomer,' a new style that gives her another shot.

title: Don 2
desc: An international gangster surrenders but pulls off a daring escape, only to find himself tangled in a web of treachery and betrayal lurking around every corner.

title: Gully Boy
desc: A street rapper from Mumbai's slums rises against odds to voice truth through music, blending dreams, rebellion, and rhythm in a story of resilience.

title: Toofan (2021 )
desc: The Story Of A Boxer And The Struggles He Faces On His Journey To Get To The National Level Competition.

title: Iqbal
desc: A deaf and mute boy dreams of playing cricket for India, battling social stigma and physical limitations with determination and a mentor's support.

title: Kuch Kuch Locha Hai
desc: Praveen Patel, A 45-Year-Old Married Businessman, Is Approached By Shanaya, An Actress, Who Wants To Move In With Him To Prepare For A Role. He Then Pretends To Be Single To Impress Her.

title: Yaara
desc: A group of close friends who ran a ruthless criminal gang when they were young get separated due to several circumstances. When they reunite after many years, it is to help their friend in need.
